{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Redirect|Trawler|the music track|Trawler (music track)|the sailing activity|Deep sea trawling}} {{HasStrategy}} {{Infobox Activity |name = Fishing Trawler |image = [[File:Fishing Trawler.png|300px]] |release = [[28 July]] [[2003]] |update = Trawler mini game |type = Minigame |members = Yes |location = [[Port Khazard]] |players = 1+ |skills = [[Fishing]] |requirements = None
{{SCP|Fishing|15|link=yes}} to catch fish |currency = None |tutorial = None |music = [[Trawler Minor]], [[Trawler (music track)|Trawler]] |map = {{Map|name=Fishing Trawler|x=2669|y=3161|zoom=2}} |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} [[File:Fishing Trawler logo.png|left]] '''Fishing Trawler''' is a [[Fishing]] [[minigame]] in which players must prevent [[Murphy]]'s trawling boat from sinking for five minutes. The minigame can be played at any level, but 15 [[Fishing]] is required to receive any rewards. To play, board the fishing trawler docked at [[Port Khazard]] and wait for the next voyage. On return to the mainland, players who earned enough contribution points during the minigame may search the [[trawler net]] to receive an assortment of [[Fishing Trawler#Rewards|fish]] and [[Fishing]] experience, with a chance to receive pieces of the [[angler's outfit]]. The activity is notable as the fastest method of earning the [[angler's outfit]]. Playing on the official worlds offers a faster and more relaxed route to obtaining the outfit, while playing solo or in small groups can result in more fish and [[Fishing]] experience. Starting a Fishing Trawler expedition is an [[Ardougne Diary#Easy|easy Ardougne Diary]] task. Catching a [[Raw manta ray|manta ray]] (requiring 81 Fishing) and then cooking it in Port Khazard (requiring 91 [[Cooking]]) is an [[Ardougne Diary#Elite|elite Ardougne Diary]] task.
